target.description: Exactly one of 'pid', 'exe', or 'path' must be provided to identify the target process. This is a map with optional keys, but only one may be set at a time in practice.

target.pid.description: PID of the process to limit

target.exe.description: Name of the executable program file (basename)

target.path.description: Absolute path to the executable program file

limit.description: CPU percentage limit (1–100, or higher on multi-core). Mandatory in most use cases.

cpu_cores.description: Number of CPU cores available (override auto-detection). Usually auto-detected.

signal.description: Signal to send when cpulimit exits (e.g., SIGTERM, SIGCONT)

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode to show control statistics

kill.description: Kill the target process instead of throttling it

lazy.description: Exit silently if no suitable target process exists or dies

monitor_forks.description: Watch and throttle child processes (use with caution)

foreground.description: Run in foreground while waiting for launched process to finish

launch_command.description: Command line to launch and limit (list of arguments). When set, cpulimit becomes the launcher.
